architecture_title: DINOv2 Macro Domain Gate + YOLOv8n + Confidence-Based Reliability Estimation
justification: Empirical evidence proves a clear separation of concerns: DINOv2 foundation embeddings provide flawless macro domain shift detection (AUROC 1.0000, 100% India detection with 1.46% China false alarm at p99=0.4491) but add negligible sample-level failure predictive power (AUROC 0.54-0.60 alone). Conversely, YOLO confidence features provide strong sample-level failure prediction (AUROC 0.8166-0.8650, 60.5% error reduction) but cannot detect when the whole domain has shifted out of distribution. Architecture C combines DINO Domain Gating at the input boundary with YOLO Confidence Reliability at the decision boundary, reducing unsafe automated acceptance on out-of-domain data from 97.67% down to 0.00%.

targets_evaluated.T4: Complete Recall (100% at IoU >= 0.50 where GT > 0)
